lines: Fable 5.2 is here for your longest and toughest coding
tasks. It draws down usage faster than Opus 5.5. Switch
❯ Call AskUserQuestion exactly once now with two questions,
in this order: "Which test features?", header Features,
color?", header Color, options Amber (description Warm)
and Blue (description Cool), single select. After
answers, reply exactly ELWOOD_GROUP_DONE. Do not inspect
files or use any other tool. These are synthetic
preferences that only the user can answer.
Enter to select · Tab/Arrow keys to navigate · ctrl+g to
edit in Nvim · Esc to cancel
